name: timeline
description: A dated timeline: events placed by date on a time axis, optional era bands beneath it (nested levels: eons/periods, ages, reigns), thumbnails (portraits or pictures) beside labels, and links, details and sources on each event's info card. Choose it for ANY sequence of events in time — intellectual history (authors with their papers), historical periods, deep time (scale log_ago), a project plan or a patient pathway. Placement is computed: labels never overlap; when space is short, lower-priority events shrink to dots and return as the view zooms in. Animate view.from / view.to (numbers) to zoom or scroll; paused viewers pan and pinch. Keep labels to a word or three — the voice says the sentence.
interaction: drag along the timeline to scroll through time; pinch or ctrl-scroll to zoom (more events appear); tap an event for its card

scale.description: linear (default): calendar years. log_ago: log of years before present — each factor of ten gets equal width (geology, evolution, prehistory).

date.description: A year (negative = BCE) or a string: "1963", "3300 BCE", "1969-07", "66 Ma", "4.5 Ga", "12 ka", "now".

sublabel.description: A few words under the label.

portrait.description: A person's name: their Wikipedia portrait as a thumbnail (true = the label).

links.description: Paper (DOI/PubMed/JSTOR), YouTube, PDF or Wikipedia URLs on the card.

details.description: A sentence or two for the card.

priority.description: 1 = always shown; higher gives way first when crowded (default 2; emphasize = 1).

view.description: Window shown (default: all). Numbers when animated.

start_label.description: Caption at the axis's left end.

milestones.description: Old undated form: 2–8 evenly spaced steps; prefer events.

element_ids.event_<id>: an event: its dot, stem, thumbnail and label (event_<i> when it has no id)
element_ids.axis: the time axis with its ticks
element_ids.title: figure title, when set

examples.request: How did the economics of health care begin?
